title: PictoRelay
description: Real online PictoChat between DS, 3DS, PC and Mobile
author: HollowOwl
long_description:
**Features:**

- 16 people per room
- Authentic interface
- Chat with PC and Mobile

**Requirements:**

- Any 2DS or 3DS model
- Active Wi-Fi connection
- 7 free blocks on the SD card

More info: https://pictorelay.com/3ds
